book.name: 1 Korint
book.title: 1 Korint Nalob̃ulat napisulan na-vǝha-sual-an aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Korint

content: Na-bubulah-vat-an m̃os alat siYesu a Jerusalem
Gagai nuke nisor husur na-bubulah-vat-an m̃os alat siGot. Nuke mitigol husur nǝsa notokel mai alat siYesu len naut tiltile gail len naprovens Kalatia.

Len nǝmariboŋ metǝkav hǝn nawik, gamit ṽisusua mǝteriŋ nǝvat ideh gail tipat, nahudhuvat hǝn nap̃urp̃uran samito. Ale sahsah tuan nǝvat enan hǝn b̃eutaut vir nagǝman sagw, savi hǝn nǝboŋ en beti mǝtb̃ebubulah vat.
Ale nǝboŋ nǝb̃egǝmai, mitilekis hǝn gamit galevis mǝttonau ke lotovoi. Dereh nilav nalob̃ulat napisulan mai galito, ale nesǝvat galito hǝn lǝb̃itariv naviolan samito vi Jerusalem.
Ale b̃inor hǝn ginau am nǝb̃ivan ei, dereh galit litah mai ginau len nǝyaran sagw.
Na-sor-utaut-an
Dereh niyar tur len naprovens Masetonia. Ale nǝboŋ nǝb̃iyar tur len naprovens Masetonia b̃inoŋ, dereh negǝm hǝn gamito.
Hum ma nǝb̃itoh mai gamit b̃ebǝlav kǝkereh, o vǝbar nahǝbati naut susus lǝb̃inoŋ hǝn mǝtb̃evi tarhǝt sagw len nǝyaran van, vi lan naut ideh nǝb̃evi lan.
Husur nomǝtahun nǝb̃iyar tur len naut samit tutut ŋai. AGot b̃idam̃ hǝni, nuvatvat viri ke nitoh tebǝlav kǝkereh mai gamito.
Be dereh nitoh a Efesus van vǝbar naPentikost, nǝhanan hǝn nǝmatuan.
Husur aGot esǝŋav hǝn nab̃iltip̃isal hǝn nǝb̃igol nab̃iltiuman b̃iṽan hǝn naṽit b̃isob̃ur, naut kǝmas nǝvanuan tosob̃ur lotomǝtahun nauman sagw.
Nǝboŋ aTimoti b̃egǝmai, samtigol natideh hǝn b̃emǝtahw lan, len natohan san mai gamito, husur gai igol nauman siNasub̃ sum̃an ŋai ginau notogole.

Gamit ideh sateŋit nǝhon van hǝni, satinau ke tovi ut kǝmas. Be mǝtevi tarhǝt san len nǝyaran san hǝn b̃etǝlmam gǝm hǝn ginau, nǝlon topul hǝn natǝm̃at. Nutoh vir gai mai nǝbathudud nadǝlomian galevis am.

Nuke nisor husur awawa sidat len nadǝlomian, aAp̃ollos. Nukel buni ke timastah mai awawa nadǝlomian gail am lǝb̃ivan hǝn gamito, be savi nalǝŋonian san hǝn b̃ivan gagai. Nǝboŋ b̃ikad nap̃isal, dereh tivan hǝn gamito.
Nǝ-maris-kotovi-an
Mǝtehulahul. Mǝteil gǝgat len nadǝlomian. Mǝteil b̃ur namǝtahwan. Mitidaŋ.
Nǝsa mǝtb̃igole, mitigol galen p̃isi len na-lǝmas-buni-an.
Bathudud nadǝlomian, mǝtolǝboi aStefanas mai nǝbathudud san. Galit nametǝkav lotokad nadǝlomian len naprovens Akaia, ale loviol hǝn galito hǝn lǝb̃evi tarhǝt silat siGot. Nous gamit, noŋir gamit ke,
len na-lǝmas-buni-an mǝteriŋ gamit len navǝlalito, galit mai nǝvanuan p̃isi lotob̃on mai galito len nauman, lotoum habat m̃os na-kel-uri-an tovoi.
Nohǝhaṽur masuṽ len nagǝman siStefanas, aFortunatus mai aAkaikus, husur alalum̃an galegai lovi tarhǝt sagw, gel gamit mǝtsalǝboi mǝtb̃igole.
Lugol nolǝŋon ivoi am len nǝlogw, hum lotogole hǝn gamit tia. Husur enan nuke, mǝteputsan nǝvanuan lotomaienan len nǝnauan samito.

Alat siYesu len naut tiltile len naprovens Asia lukel na-ke-ivoi-an mai gamito. AAkwila mai aPrisilla, mai alat siYesu lotob̃onb̃on len naim sǝlaru lohǝhaṽur hǝn lotokel na-ke-ivoi-an mai gamit len Nasub̃.
Gegai nǝbathudud p̃isi len nadǝlomian lukel na-ke-ivoi-an mai gamito. Len na-lǝmas-buni-an siGot len nǝlomito, mǝtesum̃ gabag hǝn nǝtarhomit gail hǝn mǝtb̃ikel na-ke-ivoi-an sagw mai gamito.
Ginau aPol nutos na-ke-ivoi-an egai hǝn navǝlagw sǝb̃ogw ŋai.
Avan ideh asike b̃elǝmas bun Nasub̃—tipanis sile! Masta sidato, gegǝmai!
Nasub̃ aYesu teviol kǝmas hǝn navoian mai gamito.
Len aKristo aYesu, na-lǝmas-buni-an sagw tipat len gamit p̃isi.

footnotes.text: 16.8 NaPentikost evi nǝhanan hǝn nǝmatuan topat len nǝmariboŋ tovi 50 husur nǝPasova.
16.22 KelV 22.20. Len naut egai, ike Maranata tovi nasoruan ta Aram namilen ke Masta sidato, gegǝmai.
